property.name: allPageItems
property.shortdesc: Lists all page items contained by the Spread.

property.name: allGraphics
property.shortdesc: Lists all graphics contained by the Spread.

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the Spread within its containing object.

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the Spread.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the Spread (a Document).

property.name: pageItems
property.shortdesc: The page items collection, which can be used to process all page items in a container (such as a document, page, or group), regardless of type.

property.name: endnoteTextFrames
property.shortdesc: A collection of endnote text frames.

property.name: graphics
property.shortdesc: A collection of imported graphics in any graphic file format (vector, metafile, or bitmap).

property.name: appliedMaster
property.shortdesc: The master spread applied to the Spread. Can also accept: NothingEnum enumerator.

property.name: pageTransitionDirection
property.shortdesc: The direction of the page transition.

property.name: pageTransitionDuration
property.shortdesc: The duration of the page transition.

property.name: idmlComponentName
property.shortdesc: The IDML component name of the Spread.

property.name: showMasterItems
property.shortdesc: If true, displays master page items on document pages in the spread.

property.name: spreadHidden
property.shortdesc: If true, denotes that the spread is hidden. If false, denotes that the spread is not hidden. For override, pass true to hide and false to unhide

property.name: allowPageShuffle
property.shortdesc: If true, guarantees that when pages are added to a spread it will contain a maximum of two pages. If false, allows pages to be added or moved into existing spreads. For override information, see preserve layout when shuffling.

property.name: flattenerOverride
property.shortdesc: The transparency flattener preferences override for the spread.

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: name
property.shortdesc: The name of the Spread; this is an alias to the Spread's label property.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: removeOverride
method.shortdesc: Removes the override from a previously overridden master page item.

method.name: detach
method.shortdesc: Detaches an overridden master page item from the master page.

method.name: transform
method.shortdesc: Transform the page item.

parameter.name: in
parameter.shortdesc: The coordinate space to use

parameter.name: from
parameter.shortdesc: The temporary origin during the transformation. Can accept: Array of 2 Reals, AnchorPoint enumerator or Array of Arrays of 2 Reals, CoordinateSpaces enumerators, AnchorPoint enumerators, BoundingBoxLimits enumerators or Long Integers.

parameter.name: withMatrix
parameter.shortdesc: Transform matrix. Can accept: Array of 6 Reals or TransformationMatrix.

parameter.name: replacingCurrent
parameter.shortdesc: Transform components to consider; providing this optional parameter causes the target's existing transform components to be replaced with new values. Without this parameter, the given matrix is concatenated onto the target's existing transform combining the effect of the two. Can accept: MatrixContent enumerator, Array of MatrixContent enumerators or Long Integer. (Optional)

parameter.name: consideringRulerUnits
parameter.shortdesc: If true then a ruler based origin is interpreted using ruler units rather than points. The default value is false. This parameter has no effect unless the reference point is specified relative to a page. (Optional)

method.name: transformValuesOf
method.shortdesc: Get the transformation values of the page item.

parameter.name: in
parameter.shortdesc: The coordinate space to use

method.name: resolve
method.shortdesc: Get the coordinates of the given location in the specified coordinate system.

parameter.name: location
parameter.shortdesc: The location requested. Can accept: Array of 2 Reals, AnchorPoint enumerator or Array of Arrays of 2 Reals, CoordinateSpaces enumerators, AnchorPoint enumerators, BoundingBoxLimits enumerators or Long Integers.

parameter.name: in
parameter.shortdesc: The coordinate space to use.

parameter.name: consideringRulerUnits
parameter.shortdesc: If true then a ruler location is interpreted using ruler units rather than points. The default value is false. This parameter has no effect unless the reference point is specified relative to a page. (Optional)

method.name: placeXML
method.shortdesc: Places the XML element onto a page. If the place point is above an existing page item, place the XML element into the page item.

parameter.name: using
parameter.shortdesc: The XML element to place.

parameter.name: placePoint
parameter.shortdesc: The point at which to place the object, specified in the format [x, y].

parameter.name: autoflowing
parameter.shortdesc: If true, autoflows placed text. (Optional)

method.name: setContent
method.shortdesc: Replaces the content of XML element with content imported from a file.

parameter.name: using
parameter.shortdesc: The file path to the import file.

parameter.name: relativeBasePath
parameter.shortdesc: Base path used to resolve relative paths. (Optional)

method.name: placeAndLink
method.shortdesc: Deprecated: Use contentPlace method. Original Description: Create a linked story and place it into the target.

parameter.name: parentStory
parameter.shortdesc: The story to place and link from.

parameter.name: placePoint
parameter.shortdesc: The point at which to place (Optional)

parameter.name: destinationLayer
parameter.shortdesc: The layer on which to place (Optional)

parameter.name: showingOptions
parameter.shortdesc: Whether to display the link options dialog (Optional)

method.name: contentPlace
method.shortdesc: Duplicate an object and place it into the target.

parameter.name: pageItems
parameter.shortdesc: One or more page items to place or load

parameter.name: linkPageItems
parameter.shortdesc: Whether to link pageItems in content placer (if true it will override link stories value) (Optional)

parameter.name: linkStories
parameter.shortdesc: Whether to link stories in content placer (only applicable for single story, pageItem links will also be created in case of more than one item) (Optional)

parameter.name: mapStyles
parameter.shortdesc: Whether to map styles in content placer (Optional)

parameter.name: placePoint
parameter.shortdesc: The point at which to place (Optional)

parameter.name: destinationLayer
parameter.shortdesc: The layer on which to place (Optional)

parameter.name: showingOptions
parameter.shortdesc: Whether to display the link options dialog (Optional)

method.name: createGuides
method.shortdesc: Creates multiple guides on all pages of the spread.

parameter.name: numberOfRows
parameter.shortdesc: The number of rows to create on each page. (Optional)

parameter.name: numberOfColumns
parameter.shortdesc: The number of columns to create on each page. (Optional)

parameter.name: rowGutter
parameter.shortdesc: The height of the gutter between rows. (Optional)

parameter.name: columnGutter
parameter.shortdesc: The width of the gutter between columns. (Optional)

parameter.name: guideColor
parameter.shortdesc: The color to make the guides, specified either as an array of three doubles, each in the range 0 to 255 and representing R, G, and B values, or as a UI color. Can accept: Array of 3 Reals (0 - 255) or UIColors enumerator. (Optional)

parameter.name: fitMargins
parameter.shortdesc: If true, the row height and column width are calculated based on the space within the page margins. If false, row height and column width are calculated based on the full page. (Optional)

parameter.name: removeExisting
parameter.shortdesc: If true, removes existing guides when creating new ones. (Optional)

parameter.name: layer
parameter.shortdesc: The layer on which to create the guides. (Optional)

method.name: move
method.shortdesc: Moves the spread.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The location of the spread relative to the reference object or within the document. (Optional)

parameter.name: reference
parameter.shortdesc: The reference object. Note: Required when the to parameter specifies before or after. Can accept: Spread, Page or Document. (Optional)

method.name: remove
method.shortdesc: Deletes the Spread.

method.name: duplicate
method.shortdesc: Duplicates the spread.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The location of the spread relative to the reference object or within the document. (Optional)

parameter.name: reference
parameter.shortdesc: The reference object. Note: Required only when the to parameter specifies before or after. Can accept: Spread, Document or MasterSpread. (Optional)

method.name: place
method.shortdesc: Places the file.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.shortdesc: The file to place

parameter.name: placePoint
parameter.shortdesc: The point at which to place (Optional)

parameter.name: destinationLayer
parameter.shortdesc: The layer on which to place (Optional)

parameter.name: autoflowing
parameter.shortdesc: Whether to autoflow placed text (Optional)

parameter.name: withProperties
parameter.shortdesc: Initial values for properties of the placed object(s) (Optional)

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

parameter.name: key
parameter.shortdesc: The key.

parameter.name: value
parameter.shortdesc: The value.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

parameter.name: key
parameter.shortdesc: The key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the Spread.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

method.name: toSpecifier
method.shortdesc: Retrieves the object specifier.

method.name: addEventListener
method.shortdesc: Adds an event listener.

parameter.name: eventType
parameter.shortdesc: The event type.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: captures
parameter.shortdesc: This parameter is obsolete. (Optional)

method.name: removeEventListener
method.shortdesc: Removes the event listener.

parameter.name: eventType
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event type.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: captures
parameter.shortdesc: This parameter is obsolete. (Optional)
